prompt:
Illustrazione generata con ChatGPT (generazione immagini di OpenAI) dall'account dell'autore, l'8 novembre 2026, in due passaggi.
Prompt 1: A clean technical illustration in the style of a vintage patent drawing: an exploded isometric view of four thin square layers floating one above the other, joined by fine dashed vertical guide lines. From bottom to top: a database drawn as a short stack of three flat cylinders; a server layer, a flat slab with a few small chips and circuit traces; an interface layer, a smartphone-like screen showing a minimal app layout made only of simple rectangles and lines; and at the top a small neural network drawn as circles connected by straight lines. Thin, uniform black ink lines only. No fills, no shading, no gradients, no shadows, no color, no text, no letters, no numbers, no labels. Precise and minimal, centered, with generous empty space around the object. Square 1:1 format, PNG with a transparent background (if transparency is not possible, a pure white #FFFFFF background).
Prompt 2: Great. Keep exactly the same style, line weight, layers, dashed guide lines and transparent background, but draw the neural network at the top in the same isometric perspective as the other three layers: its nodes and connections lying on a thin square plate, parallel to the plates below and aligned with the dashed guide lines. Still no text, no letters, no numbers, no shading, no fills, no color. Square 1:1, PNG with transparent background.
Lavorazione: linee portate all'inchiostro del sito (#0a0a0a) mantenendo l'alfa, rifilato ai margini trasparenti con un margine del 3%, WebP senza perdita 624x1141.
